I am an undergraduate student majoring in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics. I am currently an exchange student at the University of California, Berkeley. My home university is [Xiamen University Malaysia](https://www.xmu.edu.my/DOM).

I am generally interested in **High-Dimensional Statistics**, **Stochastic Processes**, **PDEs**, and **Computational Topology**, combining computational methods with empirical analysis.

Here is my [CV](cv.pdf) and [GitHub](https://github.com/chamberlainzhang0821).
